title: Argument
description: An argument for one option of a matter. Owned by Commons.

source_refs.description: IDs of the source items or source documents the argument cites.

author_nym.description: The author's pseudonym inside Commons, never a person.

kind.description: argument: a reason someone gives. position: who took this side (for example a council group's recorded vote), without reasons. proposal: an option a resident proposed in a public consultation, with the reason they gave.

attribution.description: Who made the argument, as the public source names them: an institution, a council group, or 'a resident' for a consultation contribution. Never a private individual's name.

source_url.description: A link a reader can open to see the argument at its public source.
